headline: Holiday revenue +12% (+10% cc) with 18% AUR growth; adj. EPS $6.22; FY26 outlook raised but Q4 margin to dip on tariffs.
guidance_note: FY26 cc revenue growth raised to high-single to low-double digits (from 5-7%), op margin +100-140 bps; Q4 margin contraction expected on tariffs and marketing.
key_messages: North America revenue +8% to $1.1B; NA comps +7% (stores +6%, digital +7%); NA wholesale +11%.
Asia +22%, China up more than 30%; Europe +12% reported but only +4% cc, Europe margin down 150 bps.
DTC AUR +18% on full-price selling and fewer promotions; gross margin 69.9% (+150 bps) as AUR and cotton offset tariffs.

consumer.income_split: Coverage attributed the beat partly to continued spending from higher-income consumers.
consumer.big_ticket: Strong holiday demand across geographies and consumer segments.
consumer.pricing: AUR +18% with lower promotions; higher tariffs offset by full-price sales and lower cotton costs.
consumer.quote: This holiday season, our teams delivered strong, high-quality growth across geographies and consumer segments

macro_read: Higher-income US shoppers spent freely at full price over holiday 2025 even as tariffs raised costs, supporting a K-shaped consumer picture.
notes: Growth is as reported; a constant-currency North America figure was not found. North America retail comps are in the key messages.
EPS consensus null: one source compares reported $5.82 with $5.80 estimate, another adjusted $6.22 with $5.81.
Shares fell nearly 7% early on Q4 margin outlook; close not confirmed, so null.
The digital figure is the North America digital comp.
